comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
The devenv herdr log shows the pane this was observed on being closed a few minutes later, with a Claude session in it. Times local (UTC-5), from /home/.config/herdr/sessions/muster/herdr-server.log:

    17:29  window still lists p224xypzs3 (backend w5:p1) as 'src · claude · Lore status confirmation', idle
    17:33:47  api.request  method="pane.close"  request_id="muster:3"
              workspace.close workspace_id="w5"
              pane.exit pane_id=21 status=ExitStatus { code: 1, signal: Some("Hangup") }
              pane session terminated pane=21 pid=1083673 signal=Terminate
    17:33:52  persist.clear - herdr had nothing left to remember

w5:p1 is the pane that had been displaced by the second window and was drawing 'close this pane and open it again to bring it back here'. The close came from Muster's API, so it was the pane being closed in the window rather than the agent exiting. Whether the message was followed is not in the log; what the log does show is that the advice was on screen and the pane it was about was closed while it was.

No devenv pane survived: the whole w4 workspace went the same way between 16:23 and 16:27, which was deliberate. This card is about w5:p1 at 17:33, which was not.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A pane whose terminal was taken by another window shows two remedies at once, and they contradict each other. The pane body says to close the pane; the toast beside it says to run `muster pane reattach`. Closing the pane ends the agent, which is what `4aaec46` (kan `a_2KIPfvt7L`) went through the codebase to stop the app advising.

Seen on 0.7.0, 2026-09-08, driving two windows on one home. The devenv pane `p224xypzs3` was showing in window A; window B was navigated onto the same tab and took the terminal. Window A then drew:

    muster-bridge: pane w5:p1 is now being shown somewhere else, so this
    window has stopped drawing it.
    Only one client may hold a herdr terminal. The agent is untouched;
    close this pane and open it again to bring it back here.

    Process exited. Press any key to close the terminal.

and, in the toast at the same moment, the sentence `respawn.rs::yielded` builds: "Whichever window is showing it now is the one to type into. To bring it back here instead, run `muster pane reattach --pane p224xypzs3`."

`4aaec46` fixed exactly this defect - its message says so: "The advice destroyed what it was recovering. 'Closing this pane and opening it again starts a fresh bridge' is true and it ends the agent." It rewrote `typeable.rs`, `respawn.rs`, `session.rs` and `watchdog.rs`. It did not touch `crates/muster-bridge/src/main.rs:620`, which is the takeover branch and the one a person reads first, because it is printed into the pane at full width rather than into a box in the corner.

`ClosePane` goes to the daemon (`handler.rs:123`), so following the pane's advice on a pane running an agent ends that agent. The reader is under exactly the pressure `a_2KIPfvt7L` describes: their pane just went dark and the big text tells them to close it.

Two smaller things in the same view, neither the point of this card:

- "Press any key to close the terminal" is libghostty's own held-open screen and no key reaches it (`SurfaceView.swift:140`), so the line is inert rather than dangerous. It still sits under advice that says to close the pane, which makes it read as the way to do that.
- The takeover case does not need a remedy sentence of its own at all. `muster pane reattach` exists now; before it, closing and reopening was the only way back, which is why this sentence was written.

## Directions

- Say what the toast says, from the same builder. `respawn.rs::reattach_command` already formats it and the bridge has the pane key.
- Or say nothing in the pane and let the toast carry it, since the toast is correct and the pane text cannot be dismissed.
- Either way the sentence "close this pane and open it again" should not exist anywhere in the tree.

## Validating a fix

- Two windows on one machine, both onto one pane. The displaced window's pane text names `muster pane reattach` and no text anywhere advises closing the pane.
- `rg 'close this pane'` over the tree finds nothing.
title: ☠️ A displaced pane still advises closing itself, which ends the agent
